# Contributing to Islam.wiki

Thanks for your interest in contributing to Islam.wiki!

## Getting Started

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b feature/your-feature`
3. Make your changes with clear commit messages
4. Run tests and linter before opening a PR: `pnpm test && pnpm lint`
5. Open a pull request with a clear description of your changes

## Content Guidelines

- All Islamic content must align with Ahl us-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah methodology
- Cite sources for all theological claims
- Ensure accurate transliteration of Arabic terms
- Test RTL rendering for Arabic text

## Code Quality

- Use TypeScript with strict mode
- Format code with Prettier: `pnpm format`
- Run linter: `pnpm lint`
- Add tests for new functionality: `pnpm test`
- Follow existing code patterns and conventions

## Questions?

Open a discussion at https://github.com/ummeco/islamwiki/discussions

We follow a standard Code of Conduct — see CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
